query:
SELECT 
                        id, 
                        email, 
                        first_name, 
                        last_name, 
                        role as "role: Role", 
                        created_at as "created_at!", 
                        updated_at as "updated_at!"
                    FROM users
                    WHERE role = $1
                        AND (
                            email ILIKE $2
                            OR first_name ILIKE $2
                            OR last_name ILIKE $2
                        )
                    ORDER BY created_at DESC
                    LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
